selection_reason: User-controlled 'substitute' parameter from elFinder::$currentArgs -> directly used as image size constraint -> controls image processing operations

User-controlled 'substitute' value -> cast to integer -> may not fully sanitize malicious input before image processing
Opens a file for writing at a constructed temporary path -> if path is attacker-controlled or predictable, could lead to arbitrary file write.
Calls imageUtil with a temporary file path -> if path is attacker-controlled, could lead to arbitrary file processing or injection.
Deletes a temporary file -> if path is attacker-controlled, could lead to arbitrary file deletion.
Modifies file timestamp of a temporary file -> could affect file lifecycle or cleanup logic.
